podcast.body: This song was written by George Harrison around the same time that Led Zeppelin's "Babe, I'm Gonna Leave You" was conceived, both featuring a similar guitar riff but with different tempos. "Which by the way was conceived around the same time that George Harrison wrote while my guitar gently weeps for the Beatles. Same riff, but different tempo."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Written by George Harrison, this song was conceived around the same time as Led Zeppelin's "Babe I'm Gonna Leave You," highlighting the commonality of musical ideas and guitar riffs across different artists. "George Harrison wrote while my guitar gently weeps for the Beatles."
